title: pentagonocarpus hispidus
intro: Pentagonocarpus hispidus, commonly known as the prickly ash, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and calm irritated skin. The bioactive constituents of P. hispidus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
